children: Hornbeck Offshore posted investor presentation highlighting pro forma combination with Helix and $1.9B pro forma revenue.
Merger with Helix completed Sept 1, 2026; pro forma combined fleet of 85 vessels and ~327M fully diluted shares.
Pro forma 2Q2026 LTM revenue of $1.9B and LTM adjusted EBITDA of $551M; pro forma net debt / LTM EBITDA ~0.4x.
Three operating segments: Marine Transportation ($606M), Subsea Services ($414M) and Well Intervention ($851M) drive diversification.
Expected synergies of ~$75M revenue and ~$75M cost benefits, targeting ~$150M incremental annual run-rate within three years.
Strong liquidity and cash generation: pro forma cash ~$518M, adjusted free cash flow $290M (2Q2026 LTM) and 53% adj. FCF conversion.
